# Antigravity Context Monitor **Live context usage and compaction threshold monitor in the Antigravity side pane.** **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-0ea5e9.svg)](#installation) [![Sidecar UI](https://img.shields.io/badge/UI-Aux%20Pane-6366f1.svg)](#how-it-works) [![i18n: EN / 中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/i18n-EN%20%7C%20%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-8b5cf6.svg)](#features) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-Zero-10b981.svg)](#project-structure)
--- ## Features - **Real-Time Context Usage** — Reads actual token counts (`input_tokens + cache_read_tokens`) directly from the active conversation transcript with **zero extra token overhead**. - **Compaction Threshold & Alerts** — Displays current usage against your compaction threshold with remaining headroom and **75% (warning)** / **90% (critical)** status indicators. - **Native Window Comparison** — Shows where the compaction threshold sits relative to the model's full context window (e.g., 256K on a 1M window). - **Cache & Growth Insights** — Tracks Prompt Cache hit rate, last turn output, next-turn baseline estimate, and a live context growth sparkline. - **Bilingual UI (English / 简体中文)** — Auto-detects locale and provides a one-click `EN / 中` toggle in the header, persisted across sessions. - **Customizable Threshold & Auto-Detection** — Switch presets (`128K`–`1M`) or set any custom value; automatically detects compaction drops and offers one-click calibration. - **Private & Local-Only** — Read-only local transcript access, loopback HTTP only, zero telemetry, and automatic light/dark theme sync. ## Installation ### Antigravity CLI ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/pinchuan54/antigravity-context-monitor ``` ### Git Clone **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/pinchuan54/antigravity-context-monitor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-monitor ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/pinchuan54/antigravity-context-monitor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\context-monitor" ``` After installing, open the auxiliary side pane (**+**) in any Antigravity conversation and select **Context** (no restart required). ## Compaction Threshold Antigravity does not currently expose its internal auto-compaction ceiling in `transcript.jsonl`. Threshold resolution uses the following priority: | Priority | Source | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 1 | **Panel setting** | Custom threshold set from the side pane UI (saved locally) | | 2 | **`AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`** | Environment variable override (`700000`, `800K`, `0.5M`, or `80%`) | | 3 | **Default reference** | `256K` tokens (or `80%` of the model window if smaller) | ## How It Works The plugin runs a lightweight Node.js sidecar (`sidecars/monitor/main.mjs`) via Antigravity's built-in `sidecar_sdk`. It performs `mtime`/`size`-cached, read-only parsing of the active conversation's `transcript.jsonl` and exposes `/api/context` over loopback (`127.0.0.1`) to the side-pane UI. ## Project Structure ```text antigravity-context-monitor/ ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest ├── README.md # Documentation (English) ├── README.zh-CN.md # Documentation (简体中文) ├── LICENSE # MIT License ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Plugin icon │ └── preview.png # Dark (EN) & Light (ZH) UI preview └── sidecars/ └── monitor/ ├── package.json # ESM manifest ├── sidecar.json # Aux-pane sidecar registration ├── main.mjs # Local HTTP & transcript parser ├── index.html # Side pane markup ├── styles.css # Theme-adaptive styles └── app.js # Polling, i18n, sparkline, and controls ``` ## Validation ```bash agy plugin validate --strict . ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

# Antigravity Context Monitor **在 Antigravity 右侧辅助面板中实时查看上下文使用量与自动压缩阈值。** [English](README.md) | **简体中文** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-0ea5e9.svg)](#安装方法) [![Sidecar UI](https://img.shields.io/badge/UI-Aux%20Pane-6366f1.svg)](#工作原理) [![i18n: EN / 中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/i18n-EN%20%7C%20%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-8b5cf6.svg)](#功能特性) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-Zero-10b981.svg)](#目录结构)
--- ## 功能特性 - **实时上下文监控（零额外 Token 消耗）** — 直接只读解析当前会话的 `transcript.jsonl`，精准统计真实 `input_tokens + cache_read_tokens`。 - **压缩阈值与预警** — 直观展示 `当前上下文 / 压缩阈值` 进度条与剩余空间，超过 **75%（黄）** / **90%（红）** 自动变色提醒。 - **原生窗口对照** — 在模型总上下文窗口（如 1M）上标出压缩阈值线位置，清晰了解触发压缩的时机。 - **缓存命中率与增长趋势** — 显示 Prompt Cache 命中率、本轮输出、下轮输入基线预估以及上下文增长曲线图。 - **中英文双语切换** — 自动适配系统语言，面板右上角支持一键切换 `EN / 中` 并持久化保存偏好。 - **自定义阈值与自动压缩检测** — 提供 `128K`–`1M` 快捷预设与自定义输入；检测到会话发生压缩时自动记录峰值并支持一键校准。 - **隐私与纯本地运行** — 仅只读本地 transcript 日志，监听 `127.0.0.1` 回环地址，零外联请求，自动跟随深浅色主题。 ## 安装方法 ### Antigravity CLI ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/pinchuan54/antigravity-context-monitor ``` ### Git 克隆安装 **macOS / Linux：** ```bash git clone https://github.com/pinchuan54/antigravity-context-monitor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-monitor ``` **Windows (PowerShell)：** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/pinchuan54/antigravity-context-monitor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\context-monitor" ``` 安装完成后无需重启 Antigravity，在任意对话右侧辅助面板（**+**）中选择 **Context** 即可打开。 ## 压缩阈值说明 Antigravity 目前未将内部自动压缩上限直接写入 `transcript.jsonl`，插件按以下优先级确定参考阈值： | 优先级 | 来源 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 1 | **面板自定义设置** | 在侧边栏面板中选择的预设或自定义数值（本地持久化） | | 2 | **`AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`** | 环境变量覆盖值（支持 `700000`、`800K`、`0.5M` 或 `80%`） | | 3 | **默认参考值** | `256K` tokens（若模型原生窗口小于 256K，则按 80% 计算） | ## 工作原理 插件基于 Antigravity 内置 `sidecar_sdk` 运行轻量级 Node.js Sidecar（`sidecars/monitor/main.mjs`），以 `mtime`/`size` 缓存方式只读解析当前会话的 `transcript.jsonl`，并通过本地回环接口 `/api/context` 为右侧面板提供实时数据。 ## 目录结构 ```text antigravity-context-monitor/ ├── plugin.json # 插件清单 ├── README.md # 说明文档（English） ├── README.zh-CN.md # 说明文档（简体中文） ├── LICENSE # MIT 开源协议 ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # 插件图标 │ └── preview.png # 深色（英文）/ 浅色（中文）界面预览 └── sidecars/ └── monitor/ ├── package.json # ESM 配置 ├── sidecar.json # Aux Pane Sidecar 注册配置 ├── main.mjs # 本地 HTTP 与日志解析服务 ├── index.html # 侧边栏页面结构 ├── styles.css # 深浅色主题自适应样式 └── app.js # 轮询、中英文切换、折线图与交互 ``` ## 本地校验 ```bash agy plugin validate --strict . ``` ## 开源协议 [MIT](LICENSE)
